title: Trashcan
description: A plugin that allows creation of a trashcan which deletes items, similar to modded implementations. Rename a chest or barrel to whatever you configure and throw some in to clear them.
body:
Purpose of this plugin is to allow creation of modded-esque trash can implementation to allow automated voiding of items for farms, or just to clean out your inventory.

How it works:
You rename a chest or barrel to whatever you set in the config.yml file (default is "Trashcan") and place it down. You can then have a hopper put items in the chest for immediate deletion, or manually place items in for delayed deletion. The delay can also be configured in the config.yml (default is 10s).
Double chests are also functional, but both sides need to be renamed.
